promotion_guardrails: Internal planes and candidate axes are not canonical CAV2 kinds.
Projection is not promotion, production integration, or publication.
Document/schema evidence is not runtime correctness.
Renderer success is not accessibility conformance or comprehension.
A private build cannot be redacted into a public derivative.
A learning-map receipt cannot close an FPR node, approve a DomainSpec relation, select profile or precedence, define quotient or retraction, or certify engine acceptance.
Candidate graph, conformance, and parity receipts cannot satisfy G-DSV2-SG.
Candidate and authoritative inputs share one normalized read model and do not fork the UI pipeline.
DomainSpec admitted relations come only from the exact owner-generated Sg and are imported unchanged.
IOLM consumer receipts cannot define predicates or obligations, author upstream handles, select a profile, change an upstream verdict, or substitute a narrow receipt for BTE breadth.
No task writes private content into arcanum/.
